config.description: Optional path to the policy file; defaults to ./DECIONIS_POLICY.md in the working directory.

config.label: Optional Presence tenant API key
config.description: Optional Presence tenant API key. When set, decionis_request_presence_verification and decionis_get_presence_verification_status register and call presence.decionis.com; without it the server stays networkless.

config.label: Optional Presence base URL (https only); defaults to https://presence
config.description: Optional Presence base URL (https only); defaults to https://presence.decionis.com.

config.label: Set to 1 to explicitly enable connected PolicyAgent tools
config.description: Set to 1 to explicitly enable connected PolicyAgent tools. Absent by default.

config.description: Required workspace UUID when PolicyAgent is enabled; verified before any change is sent.

config.description: Short-lived per-user delegated OAuth access token with authoring scopes. Used only when explicitly enabled. Never supply a shared API key.
